items.headline: New Platform Links Fashion Designers Directly to Global Manufacturers
items.blurb: Streamlines sourcing process by eliminating intermediaries and expanding access to production partners worldwide.

items.headline: Turkish Denim Producer Orta Ceases Operations
items.blurb: Design teams relying on the mill for fabric sourcing will need to identify alternative denim suppliers immediately.

items.headline: Re/Done Launches SoHo Flagship as AI-Powered Retail Lab
items.blurb: Strategic integration of machine learning into physical retail signals how brands are using data insights to enhance design and customer experience strategies.

items.headline: UK Fashion Factories Pitch Local Production Revival
items.blurb: Domestic manufacturing offers design teams speed-to-market and supply chain stability over overseas outsourcing.

items.headline: Record 300 Companies Commit to Textile Industry Safety Standards
items.blurb: Widespread accord adoption signals stronger compliance expectations and potential supply chain shifts for design and sourcing teams.
